motion.name: navigation-hover
motion.purpose: Navigation hover feedback; removed for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary retry button
components.css: .ds-primary { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control); color: var(--surface); background: var(--accent); padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-4); cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text retry button
components.description: Inline recovery at the navigation foot.
components.css: .ds-text { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; background: none; color: var(--accent); border: 0; padding: var(--space-2) 0; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation destination
components.html: Initiatives
components.css: .ds-nav { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-3); min-height: 38px; padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3); border-radius: var(--radius-control); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; color: var(--text); transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); } .ds-nav[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--accent-surface); color: var(--accent); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav { transition: none; } }

components.name: Connection status
components.description: State color paired with an explicit local-core label.
components.html: Connected to local core
components.css: .ds-status { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; display: flex; gap: var(--space-2); align-items: center; margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 11px; } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--completed); }

components.name: Loading lines
components.description: Static placeholders accompanying the opening status.
components.css: .ds-loading { display: grid; gap: var(--space-3); margin: 0 auto var(--space-6); width: min(240px, 100%); } .ds-loading span { height: 12px; background: var(--surface-hover); border-radius: var(--radius-control); } .ds-loading span:last-child { width: 70%; justify-self: center; }

narrative.overview:
A white work area and cool neutral navigation make location and connection state easy to read. Muted blue identifies the selected destination and recovery actions; fine separators and restrained type establish hierarchy.

This records the implemented U1 shell, not later portfolio or graph workflows. ../../docs/DESIGN_RULES.md remains the higher visual authority; ../../docs/PRODUCT_SPEC.md remains the product authority. The owner pinned system fonts and this code-first shell.
keyCharacteristics: White work area with cool neutral navigation.
Muted blue selection and visible keyboard focus.
Inline connection recovery and honest workflow notices.

rules.name: The Quiet Accent Rule
rules.body: Reserve blue for selection, focus and actionable recovery.

dos: Do retain all four named destinations across viewport sizes.
Do pair connection color with explicit status text.
Do show visible keyboard focus and move focus to the destination heading.
Do state unavailable workflows plainly in the main content.
Do use the original geometric SVG mark.
donts: Don't add completion percentages, status columns, avatars or embedded AI chat.
Don't turn Questions into an uncategorized inbox or interruptive popup.
Don't use color as the only state cue.
Don't infer unimplemented controls or workflow capabilities from this shell.
